fetch.rationale: The tool returns web content because it `Fetches a URL from the internet` and can return `the actual HTML content of the requested page` or extracted markdown, so attacker-controlled web pages make its output UNTRUSTED; the whole returned content is injectable. It is a SINK because the agent supplies the `url` (`URL to fetch`), so a request to an attacker-controlled host can deliver agent-supplied data encoded in the URL. SECRET is included with undetermined=true: the text advertises a generic `URL to fetch`/URI and does not explicitly say that file://, localhost, intranet, or other non-public URLs are blocked, even though it says `from the internet`; under the least-restrictive reading it may return non-public reachable URL content. It does not advertise arbitrary host code execution, so HOSTEXEC is not included.
